title: Implementing Shor's Algorithm: Breaking RSA Encryption
description: Step-by-step Shor's algorithm implementation in Qiskit. Factor integers exponentially faster than classical computers. Breaks RSA-2048 with sufficient qubits. Timeline: 2028-2030.

blocks.x: Shor's algorithm factors large integers exponentially faster than classical computers, breaking RSA encryption.
Migration urgency: Assume all encrypted data with >10 year secrecy requirement will be vulnerable.
